items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I gained a wife. I married Nancy

ctx.x: But I went out...I went out to Kane's Hitching Post... that was a restaurant in Dallas. And I went out to Kane's Hitching Post and got a job with a drummer named Spoons. And then I played there and stayed around Dallas for two or three years, opened a couple of night clubs, lost a lot of money...

Well, one of the things I gained in Dallas in '52 was I gained a wife. I married Nancy and shortly after...in '54... I decided that I'd had it with Dallas. Because you're in a rut, you see. You know, you long for New York and other places. You see, all of your friends come through on the road shows and tell you, "Man, what are you wasting your time..." So finally I came back to New York.

And when I came back to New York I met the people that owned the Metropole. That was in '54. And then, after that, I joined...I played...they had a place on Eighth Avenue, over near Madison Square Garden and I played over there for a while,
